label: Listening 1 — What's in your bag?
lines: Listening one. What's in their bags? Circle the right answer.
I'm Sara. In my bag I've got three pens and a notebook.
I'm Ben. My bag is very heavy — there's a big dictionary in it!
I'm Lucy. I've got two notebooks: one for English and one for maths.
I'm Tom. It's a rainy day, so I've got an umbrella in my bag.
I'm Mia. Look — this is my new pencil case!

label: Listening 2 — Lost and found
lines: Listening two. Lost and found. Listen and complete.
OK, everyone. Whose is this black bag? Is it your bag, Jack?
Leo, are these your books on my desk?
And that umbrella by the door is my umbrella.
Excuse me, where's my pencil case?
Look, Mia — it's under your chair.

label: Listening 3 — Follow the teacher
lines: Listening three. Follow the teacher. What do the students do?
Good morning, everyone. Please stand up.
Thank you. Now sit down and look at the board.
Open your books at page twelve. Page twelve.
Now take your notebooks and write the new words in your notebooks.
Good! Now work in pairs. Ask your partner: what's this in English?
